reasons.plausibility: Using graphene as a solid lubricant in an HEA is consistent with known tribological mechanisms, though high-temperature stability of the graphene layer remains a minor concern.
reasons.testability: A straightforward pin-on-disk comparison with clear pass/fail criteria provides a direct and practical means to falsify the claim.
reasons.usefulness: Proposing a direct route to improve lubrication in HEAs addresses a relevant engineering challenge and offers a clear path for further research.
